simple.meaning: מְנַשִּׁי (Mᵉnashshîy) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a Menashshite or descendant of Menashsheh.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Deuteronomy 4:43. The surrounding context includes family, kingship, land, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְנַשִּׁי (H4520) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מְנַשִּׁי (Mᵉnashshîy) / H4520 is traced through Deuteronomy 4:43, Deuteronomy 29:7, 2 Kings 10:33, 1 Chronicles 26:32 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.short: a Menashshite or descendant of Menashsheh
definitions.full: H4520. Menashshi מְנַשִּׁי adjective, of a people of ׳מ 1; only with article ׳הַמְֿ , as collective noun, of tribe east of Jordan: Deut 4:43 ; 2Kin 10:33 ; הַמְֿ ׳שֵׁבֶט Deut 29:7 ; 1Chr 26:32 . מְנָת see מנה
